title: Linter
tagline: Check an app class and its view without an SAP system.
summary: Static and headless-render checks over an app class and its view, without an SAP system.
useWhen: Run it (npx @abap2ui5/linter src) on every app class you write or change, before calling the work done: it checks the ABAP source and the view it builds together, without an SAP system.
